title: Global quantum phase estimation via hybrid quantum--classical learning
summary: Achieving both high precision and large dynamic range remains a central challenge in quantum metrology, as improving local sensitivity typically reduces the unambiguous estimation range. Variational quantum interferometers enhance precision but are generally limited to narrow operating regimes. Here we introduce a hybrid variational quantum--classical neural network interferometer (VQ-CNNI), where a shallow quantum circuit encodes phase-dependent measurement statistics and a neural network performs nonlinear phase reconstruction.
